name: @pondbridge/ios
description: Native iOS and Android shells for PondBridge powered by the shared web build.

scripts.copy: npm run build:web && npx cap copy ios
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.copy:android: npm run build:web && npx cap copy android
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
